option_relations.rationale: Post-viral keratitis is a general term and does not specifically relate to the provided leaves.
Post-viral immune-mediated interstitial keratitis is not directly related to the provided leaves.
Chikungunya virus–associated keratitis is a specific type of keratitis related to Chikungunya virus infection.
Chikungunya virus-induced bilateral stromal keratouveitis is a specific type of uveitis related to Chikungunya virus infection.
